name: Kraglen's Howl
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) After an enemy you've recently damaged dies, you let out a howl, granting three allies within 15 meters the Heed the Call synergy. Activating the synergy gives you and the activator 12 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 20 seconds.

name: Kvatch Gladiator
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) You gain 1475 Weapon and Spell Damage against targets who are at or below 25% Health.

name: Kyne's Kiss
lines: (5 items) When you deal direct damage while 12 meters or further from your target, you heal for 522 Health and restore 1314 Stamina. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds and the heal scales off the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina.

name: Kyne's Wind
lines: (3 items) Gain Minor Aegis, reducing damage taken from monsters by 5%.

(5 items) When you overheal yourself or a group member, you create a pool of Kyne's Blessing under the target for 4 seconds. You and group members standing in Kyne's Blessing restore 420 Stamina and Magicka every 1 second. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

name: Kynmarcher's Cruelty
lines: (5 items) When you deal direct damage, you apply one of 5 random Major debuffs to enemies within 8 meters of you for 18 seconds. This effect can occur once every 8 seconds and only if an enemy is in range. Eligible effects are Major Breach, Major Cowardice, Major Defile, Major Maim, and Major Vulnerability.

name: Lady Malygda
lines: (2 items) When you deal direct damage to a target within 12 meters, create a 5 meter area that after 1 second, quickly moves forward and then returns, dealing 812 Shock damage to enemies and applying Minor Enervation for 5 seconds, causing the target to deal 10% less Critical Damage. This effect can occur once every 15 seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Lady Thorn
lines: (2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for 10 seconds. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds. You or an ally near the blood ball can activate the Sanguine Burst synergy, dealing 2880 Disease damage to nearby enemies and applying Major Maim for 8 seconds, decreasing their damage done by 10%. Enemies can only receive Major Maim from Sanguine Burst once every 20 seconds. The damage scales off the synergy activator's Max Health.

name: Lamia's Song
lines: (5 items) When you use an Ultimate ability, you and your group members within 20 meters of you heal for 25 Health and restore 25 Magicka and Stamina per Ultimate spent.
